_comments: Agent Decision Logs - one append-only row per control-path transition of a Model Development Agent session
(PR 5 §5.1.6, D5-24). Record-change tracking is off: AgentDecisionLog's write guard refuses every update and
delete, so a Record Change would only ever record the create the row already is. CodeGen's default for a new
table turned tracking on; this record sets ONLY TrackRecordChanges (as .entity-feature-pipeline-rederivation-
leases.json and .entity-ml-scoring-runs.json do), so the entity's other attributes stay at their CodeGen values
